why:
URGENT FIX TO A GUARD I SHIPPED TODAY THAT IS REDDENING PRs RIGHT NOW. scripts/ci/check_backlog_unresolve.py (merged this evening in #12061) graded each backlog row against `origin/main`'s TIP instead of merge-base(HEAD, origin/main), so a branch that is merely BEHIND on a register reads as a silent re-opening.

MEASURED, ON A REAL PR OF MINE: #12045 was RED on `guards` and I had re-pushed it four times without reading the result — recorded against myself. The finding was `BL-20260909-PEAK-R-SENTINEL-ROWS-STILL-LIVE-WHILE-ITS-BACKLOG-ROW-READS-RESOLVED` moving `resolved -> open`. THE BRANCH HAD CHANGED NOTHING: the row reads `open` at the merge base 331bd2039 AND at the branch head 658d046bf, and `main` RESOLVED it afterwards in 5079dfefd. Against the tip that is indistinguishable from a re-opening; against the merge base it is correctly nothing at all. On a register `main` touches roughly every four minutes, nearly every open branch is behind — and `guards` is a required check, so this held correct PRs out of `main`.

THE FIX: `comparison_point()` derives merge-base(HEAD, base) and NAMES it in the output, on the PASS as well as the failure ('graded against 331bd2039488 [merge-base(HEAD, origin/main)]') — a verdict whose basis is not printed cannot be checked, and this guard's one false-positive class was precisely a wrong comparison point. Where no merge base exists (shallow clone, unrelated history) the tip is used and the output SAYS SO rather than falling back silently.

VERIFIED ON THE BRANCH IT FALSELY REDDENED: `check_backlog_unresolve --base origin/main` on claude/mi279-u5-channel-separation-clause-a now exits 0.

⚠️ THE CONTROL THIS GUARD SHIPPED WITHOUT, AND PAID FOR WITHIN HOURS — this is the part worth reading. All ten original planted controls build a LINEAR two-commit repo, where the base tip and the merge base are the SAME COMMIT, so a guard graded against either passes identically and the distinction is invisible to every one of them. The new control builds a real branch: base -> feature (touching something else entirely) while MAIN resolves the row afterwards, and asserts CLEAN. MUTATION-TESTED: deleting the one-line merge-base derivation makes that control FAIL and every other control still PASS — which is exactly why ten green controls did not catch this.

⚠️ AND IT IS A RECURRENCE, FILED AS ONE. backlog_search returns FOUR prior rows on this exact class, all against `register-field-loss`, three of them RESOLVED — and all filed the SAME DAY, one of them by this session. I then wrote the same defect into a new guard hours later. Fixing it a fifth time in a fifth file is not the remedy, so the CLASS is filed separately as BL-20260912-THE-TIP-NOT-MERGE-BASE-DEFECT-RECURRED-IN-A-GUARD-SHIPPED-HOURS-AFTER-ITS-FOURTH-FIX-AND-REDDENED-A-PR-FOR-DOING-NOTHING, with a census: of 315 files under scripts/, 24 take `--base` and 5 call merge-base. ⚠️ The 19 remainder is NOT 19 defects — 15 use a THREE-DOT range, which git already scopes to the merge base — leaving 4 candidates that each need a hand read. That distinction is stated in the row because quoting 19 would be this repo's own unstated-denominator failure.

TIER: scripts/ci/** and docs/claude/** only. No src/, no config, no order path.
